text:
ashley: planning a config-only rollout at 23:30 UTC. Scope: prod global, staged. Changes: max_inflight_per_worker 128 -> 96, default_rate_limit 150r/s -> 110r/s, preferred_batch=12 -> 9, rpc_timeout_ms 14000 -> 10000. Routing pinned to 'latency-optimized' for the window. Canary: asia-east1 for 18m.

noah: copy. rollback criteria?

ashley: rollback if p95 > baseline*1.25 OR p99 > baseline*1.2 sustained for 10m, or 5xx > 0.4%. Also watch kvcache_evictions spikes.

infra-lee: I'll enable kvcache_warm_ms=12000 on canary nodes for 6m. Adding synthetic probes and dashboard panels.

deploy-bot: [scheduled] cfg-2026-04-10-001 canary(asia-east1) at 1739123700

sre-maya: thumbs up. preflight: redwoodctl preview --env=prod --file=cfg-2026-04-10-001.json and run smoke tests.

deploy-bot: [canary applied] cfg-2026-04-10-001 -> asia-east1 at 1739123740

sre-maya: 7m metrics: p95 220ms (base 205ms), p99 860ms (base 820ms), 5xx 0.01%. no alerts yet.

noah: recommend slow ramp: 3% -> 12% -> 40% -> 100% with manual checks. ops agree?

ashley: agreed. manual approval at each stage.

deploy-bot: [rollout] -> 3% at 1739123820

sre-maya: alert: evictions up on a couple eu-west hosts at 1739123885 tied to tenant-Q. p99 on those hosts jumped to 1.5s.

ashley: pause ramp. ops hold further changes.

noah: tenant-Q runs long sequences; smaller batch hurts them. Propose hotpatch: per-tenant rule tenant-Q.batch_size=12 and tenant-Q.rate_limit=180.

deploy-bot: [hotpatch] queued per-tenant exception for tenant-Q at 1739123950

sre-maya: hotpatch applied. eu-west p99 back to 770ms, 5xx normal.

ashley: decision: no global rollback. keep global config but add tenant-Q exception. Note: document this as a recovery knob in the runbook.

noah: resume ramp after 10m hold. deploy-bot -> 12% at 1739124000

sre-maya: charts stable at 12% for 6m.

ashley: will finalize release notes: "Config-only: lowered inflight/concurrency and reduced default batch size to improve tail latency; added per-tenant exceptions for long-sequence tenants to avoid kv churn." Post summary when 100% + 30m healthy.
